finalReport.incidentTitle: Apache HTTPD Reverse Proxy Upstream 502/504 Gateway Timeout
finalReport.rootCause: Apache mod_proxy failed to establish socket connection to upstream application server (AH00898: Error reading from remote server). MaxRequestWorkers threshold was reached.
remediationSteps: Increase ProxyTimeout from 60 to 120 seconds in httpd.conf.
Increase ServerLimit and MaxRequestWorkers in mpm_event.conf: MaxRequestWorkers 800.
Inspect upstream application server health and GC pause durations.
Gracefully reload Apache server: apachectl -k graceful.

finalReport.incidentTitle: Kafka Broker Leader Partition Loss & Rebalance Storm
finalReport.rootCause: Broker heartbeat timed out (session.timeout.ms=10000). ZooKeeper / KRaft metadata lost quorum synchronization, causing partition replica out-of-sync (ISR shrinkage) and consumer group rebalance loops.
remediationSteps: Inspect broker disk I/O and JVM GC pauses: tail -n 100 kafka-server-gc.log.
Increase max.poll.interval.ms from 300000 to 600000 to prevent premature consumer ejection.
Verify topic partition ISR status: kafka-topics.sh --describe --under-replicated-partitions.
Trigger controlled leader re-election: kafka-leader-election.sh --election-type preferred.

finalReport.incidentTitle: WebLogic Server Thread Deadlock & DataSource Pool Exhaustion
finalReport.rootCause: WebLogic Server execute threads entered STUCK state (BEA-000337) waiting for response from backend database pool. Connection pool reached MaxCapacity (100) and timed out after 30000ms.
remediationSteps: Increase JDBC Connection Pool max capacity: configure MaxCapacity=150 in weblogic-ra.xml.
Investigate long-running uncommitted SQL queries blocking thread workers via WLST: threadDump().
Tune StuckThreadMaxTime from 600s to 300s to enable early alert signaling.
